description: Last night, I had the pleasure of attending the Orange County Federated Republican Women’s event where I celebrated my dear friend Angelina Jadrossich as she was elected President!!! I know she will lead with purpose and continue building strong Republican women leadership across Orange County 🤍 Angelina shows up, she does the work, and she’s driven by both passion and heart. She may be small but she is mighty!!! And I can’t think of anyone more deserving. Sending a heartfelt congratulations to the new board. Angelina Jadrossich, President Courtney Canfield Greene, First Vice President Kathy Stegenga, Second Vice President Arianna Guardascione-Birch, Secretary Heather Ubides, Treasurer Good luck, ladies. I have no doubt that the OCFRW is in excellent hands 🇺🇸
